blockers.problem: None of the four assigned pageMeta fragments exists. Zero of the 132 generated pages has its pageMeta copy, so a merge plus generator run now produces 132 MISSING_MESSAGE pages. Slug validity, locale consistency and untranslated-copy checks are all unrunnable.

Directory does not exist. None of hydroma.json, market.json, ops.json, access.json is present, so CONTRACT_SHAPES in scripts/generate-resource-pages.mjs has no rows to consume. Evidence, rowsKey and shape could not be spot-checked against a single router line.

These two pre-existing fragments carry only en and fa while admin/catalogue/market/public carry all fourteen. This is legal under the merge script contract (absent locale simply receives no keys) but it means the directory has no uniform locale set, so any new fragment cannot assume its neighbours covered a locale.

Merge-script collision risk with the incoming pages fragments. The merge refuses to overwrite an existing key and fails loudly, so a new pageMeta.<slug> that duplicates a key already present in these six files will break the merge rather than silently overwrite. Only catalogue.json currently carries pageMeta (20 slugs, all matching the catalogue); the incoming agents must diff against those 20 before adding.
